scripts.lint:root-scripts: eslint --config eslint.scripts.config.mjs scripts/production-gates.mjs scripts/production-preflight.mjs scripts/production-preflight.test.mjs scripts/build-production.mjs scripts/security-scan.mjs
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security:scan
scripts.prod:config: pnpm prod:preflight && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml config
scripts.prod:build: pnpm prod:preflight && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml build
scripts.prod:up: pnpm prod:preflight && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.prod:backup: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile ops run --rm backup --once
